items.headline: Terra Innovatum gives NRC all 18 SOLO safety report chapters for readiness review
items.what_happened: On 2026-11-04 Terra Innovatum said it had provided the NRC with all 18 chapters of the Preliminary Safety Analysis Report for its SOLO micro-modular reactor, for readiness review ahead of a formal construction permit application. The company targets a first-of-a-kind deployment in 2027.
items.why_it_matters: SOLO is a 1 MW design, so it sits in the 1-20 MW band. The 2027 date is the company's own target; a buyer should wait for the NRC readiness review and any licence step before treating it as firm.
items.binding_note: Not binding: the chapters went to NRC staff for a readiness review, which the company describes as an assessment ahead of formal construction permit application submission. No application has been filed or docketed.
